movie.title: Your Heart Will Be Broken
movie.overview: High school student Polina is saved from bullying at her new school and makes a deal with the main bully Bars: he must pretend to be her boyfriend and protect her, and she must do everything he says. During this game, the couple develops real feelings, but her family and classmates have reasons to separate the lovers.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: To escape severe harassment at her new school, Polina strikes a fake-dating deal with notorious bad boy Bars, leading to unexpected romantic feelings that are threatened by jealous peers and family secrets.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Upon transferring to a hostile new high school, Polina finds herself targeted by bullies until she strikes a high-stakes bargain with Bars, the school's notorious ringleader. In exchange for pretending to be her protective boyfriend, Polina agrees to follow his every command. What begins as a calculated game quickly evolves into genuine romantic feelings between the pair. However, hostile classmates and secretive family pressures threaten to tear them apart before their bond can fully bloom.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Struggling to fit in after transferring to a new high school, Polina quickly becomes the target of severe bullying from her peers. In a desperate bid for self-preservation, she approaches Bars, the enigmatic and feared leader among the school's troublemakers. They strike an unconventional deal: Bars will act as her fake boyfriend to shield her from harassment, while Polina must strictly obey his demands. Initially characterized by power dynamics and tense boundaries, their arrangement slowly forces both teenagers to let down their guard. As they spend more time together navigating high school social hierarchies, mutual respect turns into a deep, genuine romantic connection. However, their blossoming romance faces immediate resistance from malicious classmates determined to expose their agreement. At the same time, intense pressures and secrets from Polina's home life begin to surface, threatening her emotional stability. Bars finds himself torn between his tough reputation and his fierce desire to truly safeguard the girl he has come to love. As external forces aggressively conspire to drive them apart, the couple must decide if their fragile trust is strong enough to endure the challenge.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Your Heart Will Be Broken is an emotionally charged romantic drama that explores the thin line between control and affection. When Polina transfers to a new school, she immediately falls victim to a relentless wave of bullying. Seeking a way out, she makes a risky deal with Bars, the dominant bully who holds sway over the school's social ladder. In exchange for posing as her protective boyfriend to keep her safe, Polina agrees to fulfill any command Bars gives. As the fake-dating charade unfolds, the sharp edges of their agreement soften, revealing genuine vulnerabilities and an unexpected connection between them. Yet as their pretend relationship transforms into real love, external forces gather against them—including bitter classmates determined to undermine them and complex familial conflicts that threaten Polina's future. The narrative delivers a poignant look at youth, protection, sacrifice, and the emotional risks of opening one's heart.

story_structure.climax: External pressures reach a boiling point as secret motives and family conflicts come to light, forcing Polina and Bars to make a crucial choice about their relationship and confront those trying to separate them.
story_structure.conflict: Polina and Bars enter into a strict agreement: he will pretend to be her boyfriend and safeguard her from others, while she must obey his commands and fulfill his demands.
story_structure.resolution: The true emotional costs of their arrangement and the surrounding interference are realized, leaving the pair to navigate the painful aftermath and the reality of their feelings for one another.
story_structure.introduction: Polina transfers to a new high school where she quickly becomes the target of severe bullying. To survive, she approaches Bars, the school's most notorious bully, seeking a way to protect herself.
story_structure.risingAction: As they maintain their fake relationship, the boundary between act and reality blurs, and genuine feelings begin to grow between them. However, mounting opposition from hostile classmates and Polina's family creates dangerous obstacles, threatening to tear them apart.
